audited: souji-shokunin/SKILL.md section 'Receipt taxonomy' (lines 12-20), plus every other SKILL.md sentence that misstates installed-tool or current fleet state
summary: SKILL.md Receipt taxonomy does not describe installed tools/souji-verify.sh. pushed is specified as git fetch plus origin/main; the tool never fetches, resolves an existing remote-tracking ref (fleet: refs/remotes/origin/master), and emits pushed-unverifiable when no such ref exists. stale types, the reference sweep, and the age rule all disagree with probed verdicts. The heading's three-receipt set omits SAFE(metadata-prune). symlink-present is not a receipt string on souji-verify.sh (evidence note only; receipt stays none). souji-vault-verify.sh disagrees with souji-verify.sh on the pushed-unverifiable and symlink-present receipt fields. Seven taxonomy sentences misstate tool behavior; eleven further SKILL.md sentences misstate tool behavior or current fleet state.

The cell does not say relpath (the command cell does) and does not mention symlink fail-closed; those are omissions, not a false conjunct for the file case.

Holds as a removal rule. The tool's non-authorizing outcomes are NOT-SAFE (exit 0). The receipt field is not always the string none: see pushed-unverifiable, unreachable, secrets-refusal, unpushed, dirty, unpushed-branch.

misstatements.sentence: Receipt taxonomy — every removal needs exactly one
misstatements.actual: The table lists only pushed, moved-to-obsidian, and stale. Installed souji-verify.sh also authorizes SAFE(metadata-prune). It does not require exactly one receipt and does not record a second qualifying receipt (see M7).

misstatements.sentence: after git fetch, the commit carrying the artifact passes git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> origin/<branch>
misstatements.actual: The tool never fetches. It tests the introducing commit (git log --diff-filter=A), not the commit that currently carries the bytes, against an existing remote-tracking ref from resolve_default_ref (origin/HEAD, else the single refs/remotes/origin/* ref). No remote-tracking ref yields NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable), not a fetch failure. A dirty worktree or a later unpushed commit does not cancel SAFE(pushed) once the introducing commit is an ancestor.

The tool refuses secret-shaped path components before reading (*.env, .env, .env.*, .envrc, *credential*, *secret*, id_*, *.pem). It does not inspect file content. A nonexistent .env path is secrets-refusal. A plain missing path is unreachable. Content of a normal-named file was not probed; do not treat this as a content-inspection result.

required_cases.pushed: P1 SAFE(pushed) against refs/remotes/origin/master with no fetch. Live launch-tsukuroi.json SAFE(pushed) intro=b2f2efae7549 ref=refs/remotes/origin/master. SKILL command origin/main does not resolve.
required_cases.moved-to-obsidian: P4 SAFE when both absolute sha256s match. P23 relpath row is not a receipt. P17/P24 hash mismatch is NOT-SAFE(none).
required_cases.stale: P6/P9/P14/P15/P25 SAFE for tool scratch types older than 1 day with refs=0. P7/P8/P30 NOT-SAFE for *.tmp, out/, checkpoint.bin. P29 20h-old .scratch file is NOT-SAFE despite find -newermt 2026-10-18 count=0.
required_cases.none: P11 ordinary file NOT-SAFE(none). P3 introducing commit not an ancestor of origin/master is also receipt=none, not pushed-unverifiable.
required_cases.symlink-present: P5 souji-verify.sh NOT-SAFE receipt=none evidence=obsidian=symlink-present scope=source. It does not emit receipt symlink-present. P5b souji-vault-verify.sh --fallback --json: receipt=none reason=symlink-present verified=NOT-VERIFIED(symlink-present).
required_cases.pushed-unverifiable: P2 souji-verify.sh NOT-SAFE receipt=pushed-unverifiable. Live tools/souji-verify.sh same receipt (no refs/remotes/origin). P2b souji-vault-verify.sh --fallback: receipt=none reason=none, with pushed=unverifiable(no-default-ref) only in evidence.

omissions_not_sentences: SAFE(metadata-prune) is a removal receipt the taxonomy does not name (P26, selftest F4/E3).
NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable) is a distinct receipt on souji-verify.sh and is not named. Do not document it as the vault verifier's receipt field: that tool leaves receipt=none.
symlink-present is an evidence note on souji-verify.sh, not the receipt field. Spec text that says NOT-SAFE(symlink-present) matches souji-vault-verify.sh reason, not souji-verify.sh receipt.
Other non-authorizing receipt strings the taxonomy folds into 'no receipt': unreachable, secrets-refusal, unpushed, dirty, unpushed-branch.
Tool and default rg both miss a citation in a hidden file (P32: rg exit=1, rg --hidden finds .hidden-cite, tool SAFE stale refs=0). Shared blind spot, not a SKILL-vs-tool disagreement.

Empty directory-hash columns were not shown to authorize SAFE. A TSV row with empty sha fields was mis-parsed (bash IFS collapses consecutive tabs) and failed closed: souji-verify evidence obsidian=vault-unreachable vault=2026-10-18. Do not treat the source's empty-hash skip as observed behavior.
